interface.source: problem.txt interface list; no extra ports

semantics.clock: All sequential transitions occur on clk positive edge, as stated in problem.txt.
semantics.reset: Positive-edge asynchronous areset sets walking left and clears fall duration; reset dominates clock inputs.
semantics.initialization: No behavior before reset is specified; no RTL initial values and no oracle comparison before first reset.
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs reflect current state: left=1000, right=0100, fall=0010, dig=0001, dead=0000, ordered walk_left/walk_right/aaah/digging.
semantics.walking_priority: ground=0 => fall; else dig=1 => dig; else bump in current walking direction reverses direction. Both bumps reverse direction.
semantics.direction_memory: Retain direction during digging and falling, including entry and landing; ignore bumps in these states.
semantics.digging: Remain digging while ground=1 regardless of dig; ground=0 enters falling.
semantics.falling: Remain falling while ground=0, regardless of bumps or dig. Landing returns to remembered walking direction for duration <=20; duration >20 enters permanent dead state.
semantics.fall_cycles: Entry edge begins first falling interval. Each consecutive falling interval from one positive edge to the next counts one cycle. Thus N consecutive ground=0 samples followed by ground=1 produce N falling cycles; N=20 survives and N=21 splatters.
semantics.dead: All outputs zero until areset, regardless of inputs.
semantics.evidence: problem.txt paragraphs specifying priority, original direction, more than 20 clock cycles, landing-only death, Moore outputs and asynchronous reset

numeric.fall_counter: 5-bit unsigned saturating counter, maximum 21. Set to 1 on entering falling, increment for each continued falling interval until 21. Compare >20 on landing. No wrap for unbounded fall.
numeric.ports: All ports one bit. No signed arithmetic or quantization.

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral model using activity, direction, and unbounded integer duration, derived from original prose.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs at negative edges, model positive-edge transitions, compare outputs after nonblocking settling; also verify Moore output stability before next edge.
verification.directed: Asynchronous reset between clock edges, both directions, all walking input combinations, fall/dig/bump priorities, sustained digging, falling direction retention, landing ignores dig and bumps, lengths 1/19/20/21/22/32/257, permanent death and reset recovery.
verification.random: Deterministic randomized inputs with repeated resets, checked against independent model.
verification.success: Bounded timeout, fatal on every mismatch, explicit PASS after all checks; primary command python3 dev_check.py --label initial.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Count complete Moore falling intervals, including interval following entry, consistent with falls for more than 20 clock cycles. Explicitly test 20/21 boundary.
Unspecified; do not impose output values before reset.
